title: סטודנט/ית מנהל תכנון ובקרת פרויקטים
description:
סטודנט/ית מנהל תכנון ובקרת פרויקטים
נתב"ג
קצת על התפקיד
למפעל מלט טכנולוגיות בחטיבת כלי-טיס צבאיים דרוש/ה סטודנט/ית מנהל תכנון ובקרת פרויקטים
התפקיד כולל:
•תכנון ובקרת פרויקטים בכלים ושיטות עבודה מהמתקדמות בעולם
•הקמת תכניות עבודה לפרויקטים בתוכנת Ms Project ובקרת עמידה בלו"ז
•תכנון ובקרת תכולות העבודה בפרויקטים במערכת SAP ובמערכות EXCEL בפיתוח מקומי גמיש על פי צרכי המתכנן והפרויקט
•תכנון תחזית שעות העבודה בפרויקטים הצוותים המקצועיים בתוכנה ייעודית
•ניתוח נתונים וביצוע אנליזות בכלי BI מתקדמים בשילוב מערכות EXCEL בפיתוח מקומי גמיש על פי צרכי האנליסט
מה אנחנו מחפשים
• סטודנט/ית להנדסת תעשייה וניהול- חובה
• יתרת לימודים של שנתיים לפחות- חובה
• זמינות ל3 ימי עבודה בשבוע- חובה
• הישגים גבוהים בתחום אנליטי- יתרון
אולי יעניין אותך לדעת
חטיבת כלי טיס צבאיים רכשה את מוניטין המצוינות שלה בקרב קהילת הביטחון העולמית בזכות עשורים של ניסיון קרבי ויכולות טכנולוגיות נרחבות. השילוב בין ידע טכנולוגי עילאי וניסיון מעשי רב-שנים מאפשר לחטיבה להציע מערך מרשים של מוצרים ושירותים לצורכי התחזוקה, השדרוג והייצור של מגוון מערכות כטמ"ם.

title: Hardware System Engineer
description:
Hardware System Engineer
Tel Aviv-Yafo
Shape the Future of AI Infrastructure with VAST Data
This is a rare opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in tech history, right at the epicenter of the AI revolution.
Recognized by
Forbes
as
"the future of the market,"
VAST Data is building the foundational enterprise software powering the AI era. We engineer platforms that capture, catalog, refine, and protect massive datasets across data centers, edge, and cloud, making real-time analytics, AI training, and inference simpler and faster than ever before.
Our explosive growth is fueled by relentless engineering innovation, a customer-first mindset, and a team of fearless
VASTronauts
who thrive on solving computing's hardest problems. Join us at this pivotal moment in technology history and make a lasting impact on how the world processes data.
We are seeking a talented and experienced Software Engineer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, core data engines, and backend infrastructure.
In this role,
you will be responsible for qualifying hardware components such as servers, JBOFs, SSDs, network cards, switches, and optical transceivers. You will write requirement documents for new features, work with vendors on implementation and debugging, and transfer knowledge to internal teams, including software developers, QA, support, and manufacturing. Additionally, you will become the subject matter expert for specific hardware platforms and technologies. Join us and contribute to shaping the future of data management while being part of a fast-growing, innovative company.
Description
Required Skills:
Demonstrate a detailed system-level understanding of systems
Previous experience in hardware design, firmware design, linux device drivers and/or QA/verification of complex systems.
B.a. / B.Sc EE or CS - an advantage
Prior experience in at least one of the following technical areas:
PCIe: Link training, configuration space, configuration procedures by the OS, hot-plug, transport layer, PCIe switch, SR-IOV, experience with PCIe Gen.4+ an advantage.
Server design: x86 CPUs, BMC, IPMI, Redfish, SMBus/I2C, BIOS, UEFI, design for high availability, thermal design.
Storage systems: NVMe SSDs, NVMeoF, RAID, OCP SSDs
Networking: 100/200/400/800G Ethernet, Infiniband, RDMA, NVMeoF, QoS, Flow Control, VxLANs, Optical Tranceivers, cables and DPUs
Linux: Device drivers, memory management, hardware debug and test tools.
Requirements
Engineering

title: Operations Finance Analyst
description: Who We Are Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. What We Offer Location: Rehovot,ISR You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Operations Finance Analyst to drive financial visibility, forecasting, and decision support across operations. This role will serve as a key partner to the Operations and Finance teams, helping translate operational activities into financial insights while strengthening our forecasting and planning capabilities. What’s in it for you? High-impact role with exposure to Operations and Finance leadership. Opportunity to influence decision-making through financial analysis and business insights. Exposure to global operations and cross-functional business processes. Opportunity to leverage data, automation, and AI tools to improve financial processes and reporting. Key role in advancing operational excellence and financial discipline across the organization. Our Group The Operations Finance team partners with the Operations organization to provide financial leadership, business insights, and decision support. The team is responsible for inventory, costing, variances, forecasting, and operational performance management across global operations, while supporting continued expansion and growth initiatives. What you'll be doing Build and maintain forecasting models, planning assumptions, and financial data integrity across monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles. Analyze actual performance versus forecast, identify key drivers and variances, and translate findings into clear business insights. Prepare concise financial and operational performance reporting to support leadership reviews and decision-making. Partner closely with Operations to understand operational drivers, risks, and opportunities. Develop and improve recurring reports and dashboards, leveraging automation and advanced analytics to increase efficiency and visibility. Collaborate with Operations Finance team members on inventory, costing, and variance-related initiatives. Ensure compliance with Applied Materials Standards of Business Conduct and financial governance requirements. What should you have? Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; MBA is an advantage. At least 4 years of experience in FP&A, Operations Finance, Cost Accounting, or a related analytical role. Strong understanding of forecasting, budgeting, financial planning, and variance analysis. Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial modeling. Experience with SAP, Power BI, BI tools, or similar reporting platforms is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global environment. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into business insights. Excellent English, both written and verbal. Self-motivated, structured, and detail-oriented approach. Experience working with large datasets and process automation tools is an advantage. Familiarity with AI-enabled finance tools and advanced analytics is an advantage. Who we are? Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future. Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Not Specified Relocation Eligible: No Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
